title: Back to 1996 — Starter Bank

review.note: Research review is not committee approval or an open round.

instructions: One scored attempt per question. Correct answers earn 100 points; incorrect answers earn 0. Equal scores share the same place. No speed bonus. The committee chooses and opens the round, then closes it before publishing results. No prize is promised.
